intervals.label: planned experiment (up to 107 kg of NaI(Tl) at Canfranc)
intervals.note: Year of the earliest ANAIS document read, which presents the experiment as planned; no proposal or approval date is published in the sources read. The end is the start of the ANAIS-0 prototype run.
intervals.quote: ANAIS (Annual Modulation with NaI's) is an experiment planned to investigate seasonal modulation effects in the signal of galactic WIMPs using up to 107 kg of NaI(Tl) in the Canfranc Underground Laboratory (Spain).

intervals.note: Data of the first prototype crystal, recorded from December 2000 to August 2001; the 2002 status paper (arXiv:hep-ex/0211050) reports 2069.85 kg day from the same single-crystal prototype.

intervals.note: One Saint-Gobain crystal (ANAIS-0) operated in hall B of the LSC.

intervals.label: ANAIS-25 prototype (two 12.5 kg Alpha Spectra modules)
intervals.quote: took data at the LSC from December 2012 to March 2015

intervals.label: ANAIS-37 prototype (ANAIS-25 plus a third module)
intervals.note: The third crystal arrived on 6 March 2015 and data taking started five days later. End: the latest data cited for this set-up are a special run with two modules from October 2015 to February 2016; the end of the ANAIS-37 set-up is not stated.
intervals.quote: data taking started five days later.

intervals.label: production and installation of the nine ANAIS-112 modules
intervals.note: The 2026 review says the nine modules were built by Alpha Spectra starting in 2012; the 2017 status paper says the first module reached the LSC at the end of 2012 and the last in November 2016. The detector was assembled in early 2017.
intervals.quote: which were built by Alpha Spectra starting in 2012.

intervals.label: commissioning run
intervals.quote: ANAIS-112 detector was assembled in early 2017 and the commissioning phase was performed from March to July.

intervals.label: dark matter run (annual modulation data taking)
intervals.note: Start: 3 August 2017 (also arXiv:1812.01472). End: the 2026 review says ANAIS-112 'took data until January 2026, by which time it had a sensitivity of ~5 sigma'; the experiment's own page (undated text) says data taking would continue 'until the end of 2025'. Month precision; the exact date of the last data is not published in the sources read.

summary.plain: Nine sodium iodide crystals of 12.5 kg each (112.5 kg), arranged three by three and read by photomultiplier tubes, inside a shielded hut in hall B of the Canfranc laboratory.
summary.technical: Nine NaI(Tl) modules of 12.5 kg (Alpha Spectra Inc.), 3x3 matrix, read by photomultipliers, Mylar window for low-energy calibration, light collection of about 15 photoelectrons per keV; hut in hall B of the LSC (2450 m.w.e.).

technology.quote: ANAIS-112 experiment uses nine NaI(Tl) modules produced by Alpha Spectra Inc. (AS) in Colorado (US).
technology.value: Nine NaI(Tl) scintillator modules read by photomultiplier tubes
